claims.object_text: decreased gene and protein levels in hippocampi
claims.quote: gene and protein levels of GluR2 in the hippocampi of rats in the epileptic group were significantly reduced.

claims.object_text: cAMP signaling pathway; cocaine addiction; dopaminergic synapses
claims.quote: Network pharmacology analysis revealed a close association between quinpirole and GluR2 as well as its involvement in the cAMP signaling pathway, cocaine addiction, and dopaminergic synapses.

claims.object_text: modulation of GLUR2 protein expression linked to treatment improvement
claims.quote: This improvement was linked to the modulation of protein expression levels of GLUR2, BAX, and BCL2.
